name: wandera
description: Generate AI videos with models such as Seedance, Kling and Veo, compare them side by side, and turn them into Meta video ads.

interface.longDescription:
Wandera generates short AI videos from a text description using leading video models such as Seedance, Kling and Veo, and connects to your Facebook and Instagram ad account.

Describe a video and Wandera suggests a suitable model, shows the cost before generating, and returns a hosted MP4 link. You can also run one prompt on several models and get a side-by-side comparison page.

If you connect a Meta ad account, the same conversation can upload a video, create a campaign, ad set and ad (created paused unless you ask otherwise), pause or resume ads, change daily budgets, and report spend, CTR, CPA and ROAS.

Built by Zero Billion.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5 second 9:16 video of my product with Seedance
Compare Kling and Veo on a slow-motion coffee pour
Which of my Meta ads had the best ROAS last week?

positive.description: Pick a model for a cheap test
positive.prompt: Which video model is cheapest for a quick 9:16 test?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists models with credit prices and recommends the cheapest one that supports 9:16, without generating anything.

positive.prompt: How much would a 5 second 720p Kling 3.0 Pro clip cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a credit and dollar quote for that exact clip and spends nothing.

positive.prompt: Make a 5s 9:16 video of a golden retriever surfing at sunset with Seedance 2.0 Fast.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the generation, reports progress, and returns a playable MP4 link when done (about 1-2 minutes).

positive.prompt: Compare Veo 3.1 Fast and Kling 3.0 Standard on: a latte being poured in slow motion.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts both generations and returns a link to a side-by-side comparison page.

positive.prompt: What's my Wandera balance, and what videos did I make recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the credit balance and plan, and lists recent generations with their status and links.

negative.prompt: Generate a 60 second video with Veo 3.1.

negative.description: Meta tools without a connected ad account

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Paris next Friday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Users who already have a Wandera account use their existing credits; plans are described on wandera.ai.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: AI video generation across Seedance, Kling, Veo, Grok Imagine, Wan and MiniMax, model comparison pages, and Meta video ad tools.
